user.title: Connect to SOSGPS
user.description: Create a read-only token in SOSGPS → Account → Home Assistant. Tracker selection is managed in SOSGPS.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew SOSGPS access
reauth_confirm.description: Create a replacement token in your SOSGPS account, then enter it here.

error.invalid_input: Enter an HTTPS server origin and a valid SOSGPS integration token.
error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid, expired, or revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to SOSGPS. Check the URL, certificate, and server availability.

abort.already_configured: This SOSGPS connection is already configured.
